SpiceJet Passengers Protest Delhi Airport Over Extended Flight Delays

Approximately 200 SpiceJet passengers protested at Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport on Tuesday after their flights to Dubai experienced significant delays, extending beyond 24 hours. The passengers expressed their frustration over the prolonged waiting period and lack of clear communication regarding the flight status. Visuals from the airport showed passengers gathered, some holding placards, to voice their grievances. The airline has not yet provided a specific reason for the extensive delays.
